mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 7.8% over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 7.8% for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and non-farm payrolls indicates labor market contraction where employers reduce headcount despite low unemployment, depressing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles with FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and rising for two months, increased borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during tightening cycles, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 98.0 index points over 3 months indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 98.0 over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 880,000 units over 3 months signals weak residential construction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 880.0 over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) over 6 months indicates strong consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS increases for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes with INDPRO below 98.5 index points and declining for two months, reduced output lowers corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 98.5 and declining for 2 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
